scripts.build: npm run build -w @ahorra/domain && npm run build -w @ahorra/api && npm run build -w @ahorra/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @ahorra/domain && concurrently -n API,WEB -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @ahorra/api" "npm run dev -w @ahorra/web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @ahorra/domain && npm run test -w @ahorra/domain && npm run test -w @ahorra/api && npm run test -w @ahorra/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ahorra/domain && npm run typecheck -w @ahorra/api && npm run typecheck -w @ahorra/web
